findings: Bundle sha256 e3b4ddf74251f765a82dce2fb4f08484e359e255e0cdd32e9286801088496d49 and primary sha256 12d3ea3c05a8e76ce31aedb6ca7d3405feda7f4689f68fa4fabdb9bd0964a81a match the assignment.
